items.name: Indiranagar
items.famousFor: A 1970s layout of numbered Mains and Crosses that became the city's busiest street for bars, cafés and shops
items.cafe: The Kind on 12th Main — roasted on the premises
items.culture: Max Müller Bhavan for films and a lending library, Indiranagar Sangeetha Sabha for Carnatic music
items.park: Defence Colony Park — the shady loop between the two main roads
items.unusual: Atta Galatta — a bookshop for Indian-language books with its own poetry festival
items.food: Breakfast at The Rameshwaram Cafe, dinner at Chinita
items.walk: CMH Road → 12th Main → Champaca on 9th Main → 100 Feet Road
items.hidden: The quiet residential Crosses behind 12th Main, a minute from the noise
